svg.text: Lua computes (-2147483648)^2 = 2^62 exactly. Same value; the runtimes disagreed on how to write it.
The narrowing made the value bypass the float formatter entirely. double<->long is lossless only below 2^53.
All three byte-identical. Below 2^53 nothing changes: an integral double still prints without a decimal point (42.0 -> 42).
GoFormat.formatJsonNumber was already correct at every magnitude — the defect was upstream of it.
Exposed by the fix, and fixed too (found by review round 1)
GoFormat.sprint branched on the BOX TYPE: Integer -> "2000000", Double -> "2e+06"
Jackson gives Integer for a config literal and Double for pipeline data, so the two sides of a filter_condition
comparison used different rules. Java stopped filtering where Go and C++ filtered. Branch removed.
